Contract:
- LocalCostModel.cost and externalCost become typed fallible producers. GraphHsmm sequences failures; no throw, sentinel, or erasure into an existing state.
- One explicit checked SupportBasis is supplied at GraphHsmm invocation and passed into every local and external cost call. Do not derive authority from a model accessor.
- DefaultLocalCostModel must compute support from that same basis, not retain a second independently selectable weights coordinate. GraphHsmm validates or rebuilds every CostBreakdown against the invocation basis and derives Assessed.share/reasons.
- HsmmResult and hsmm/v4 carry the complete basis needed to recompute support. A wire-embedded basis proves only internal consistency. It must not be labelled authenticated invocation provenance unless decode is given an independently admitted expected basis/receipt and matches it exactly.
- This slice does not claim that arbitrary custom-model totals were computed from the support basis. Keep that residual explicit; do not launder support-basis consistency into total-cost-model identity.
- No source-compatible path may continue to run an unbound custom LocalCostModel. Update all 21 direct infer sites.

Courts must kill: CostBreakdown constructor/apply/copy/direct-fromProduct/Mirror doors from open-package and consumer packages with same-shape controls; all-measured-but-0.5; eligible/weighted/measured mismatch; caller basis A versus returned basis B; NaN or infinite FunctionPrior/external floor/term/total; finite-input overflow; wire basis tampering; and a decoder claiming authenticated authority from only its own embedded basis. Preserve v3 refusal and canonical v4 exact-byte courts. Run the full reference-scope JVM gate plus affected JS/Native courts, compileAll, scalafmtCheckAll, exact path audit, and fresh mutations. Existing required reviewers and documentation dependency remain. No candidate authorization, landing, close, or docs widening.
